summary: ONEOK filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market equity program for up to $1.0 billion of common stock, sold through BofA Securities as sales agent or principal, with Bank of America, N.A. as forward purchaser under a companion equity distribution agreement. Shares may be sold at market prices via NYSE ordinary brokers' transactions; the last reported price was $96.97 on September 14, 2026. Manager compensation is capped at 2.0% of gross sale price. Forward sales are expected to be physically settled, with cash or net share settlement alternatives, creating potential share overhang; proceeds timing and dilution cadence are the watch items.
